## Purpose and technical background

Establish bounded timestamp arithmetic and approved epoch/timezone round trips.

**VAL-010 historical finding:** Signed 64-bit ns is eight bytes and roughly ±292 years around epoch; unit precision is not clock accuracy

These are preserved research findings, not new source audits or experiment outcomes.

## Hypotheses

- **HYP-001:** Supported signed-nanosecond boundary values round-trip exactly under the declared epoch and timezone policy.
- **HYP-002:** Overflow and unsupported conversions produce the declared error behavior without silent wrap or precision loss.

### TST-052 — Signed nanosecond boundaries and units { #tst-052 }

Revision 1 · mandatory · correctness · automated · binding unbound

**Applicable validations:** [VAL-010 r3](../validation-coverage.md#val-010).

**Hypotheses:** HYP-001.

**Setup and prerequisites**

- Signed-64-bit nanosecond epoch/unit contract fixed; canonical minimum/maximum/negative/zero fixtures available.
- Bind the exact input/source/configuration revisions and execution or review method before running; unresolved prerequisites are not a pass.

**Procedure**

1. Convert supported boundary and unit fixtures into and out of the declared representation.
2. Compare signed values and represented instants exactly.

**Expected outcome**

- All supported boundary values round-trip exactly without silent unit scaling or sign errors.
- Representation limits are reported independently of clock accuracy.

**Independent oracle:** Arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic and precomputed epoch-relative fixtures independently define representable values.

### TST-053 — Checked timestamp overflow and invalid conversions { #tst-053 }

Revision 1 · mandatory · correctness · automated · binding unbound

**Applicable validations:** [VAL-010 r3](../validation-coverage.md#val-010).

**Hypotheses:** HYP-002.

**Setup and prerequisites**

- Arithmetic/conversion overflow policy and supported range fixed.
- Bind the exact input/source/configuration revisions and execution or review method before running; unresolved prerequisites are not a pass.

**Procedure**

1. Attempt operations one unit beyond each representable boundary and conversions with unsupported units/precision.
2. Exercise positive/negative offsets whose intermediate arithmetic could overflow.

**Expected outcome**

- Every unsupported result produces the declared explicit error with no silent wrap, truncation or incorrect instant.
- Supported nearby values continue to match exact arithmetic.

**Independent oracle:** Arbitrary-precision reference calculations classify overflow before narrowing, independently of implementation checked-arithmetic helpers.

**Execution method:** Planned automated procedure for Checked timestamp overflow and invalid conversions; bind the exact command or review checklist and applicable source/fixture revisions before execution.

**Required evidence**

- Per-case test outcomes including failures, skips and tool errors
- Registry/test revision and implementation or documentary source revision
- Exact execution command or review procedure; input/configuration hashes and applicable environment/toolchain
- Retained artifact references with SHA-256 digests
- Arithmetic input/result matrix
- Error-kind and no-wrap assertions

### TST-054 — Timezone and epoch round trips { #tst-054 }

Revision 1 · mandatory · correctness · automated · binding unbound

**Applicable validations:** [VAL-010 r3](../validation-coverage.md#val-010).

**Hypotheses:** HYP-001, HYP-002.

**Setup and prerequisites**

- Timezone/epoch policy, pinned timezone rules and ambiguous/nonexistent-local-time behavior fixed.
- Bind the exact input/source/configuration revisions and execution or review method before running; unresolved prerequisites are not a pass.

**Procedure**

1. Round-trip UTC, offset, pre-epoch and daylight-transition fixtures through supported conversions.
2. Exercise ambiguous/nonexistent local times and invalid timezone inputs.

**Expected outcome**

- Supported conversions preserve the intended instant and declared timezone metadata.
- Ambiguity/error handling matches policy; nanosecond resolution is not reported as clock synchronization accuracy.

**Independent oracle:** Independently authored instant/offset fixtures and pinned timezone rule data define conversion expectations.

**Execution method:** Planned automated procedure for Timezone and epoch round trips; bind the exact command or review checklist and applicable source/fixture revisions before execution.

**Required evidence**

- Per-case test outcomes including failures, skips and tool errors
- Registry/test revision and implementation or documentary source revision
- Exact execution command or review procedure; input/configuration hashes and applicable environment/toolchain
- Retained artifact references with SHA-256 digests
- Timezone rule/version manifest
- Instant/metadata and error comparisons
